notes: The one-hot basket file is built here from Preprocessed_Dataset.csv - the same shared cleaned file every other model in this project uses - not a separate, undocumented file.

severity_label is rebuilt here from the exact formula the severity model uses (further interventions OR transferred OR major procedure), not read from a separate file - so this notebook's definition of severe is guaranteed identical to the rest of the project's, and the fields that define the label are never themselves basket items (see Section 1).
A minimum lift threshold (1.2) is enforced - last year had none, so a rule could look confident purely because its consequent was already common in the data.

Rules are only kept if they replicate across at least 60% of 5 independent random data splits - a single-split check (used in an earlier version of this notebook) risked being lucky or unlucky by chance, the same fragility every predictive model in this project moved away from.
Redundant rules (a specific version of a more general rule, adding no real information) are pruned from the final list.
Missing/unknown values never become basket items at all, rather than being filtered out of results after the fact.
